summary: Lower a direct call to a stable class instance method to a C# instance method call when method extraction, reflection, and prototype mutation are excluded.

target.notes: Emit an instance method and a normal C# call. Methods should be virtual when subclass override behavior must remain observable.

caveats: C# method placement is not a JavaScript prototype property; reflection and method-as-value cases require separate rules.

tests.name: direct method call
tests.input: class C { m(x){ return x+1; } } console.log(new C().m(2));

tests.name: edge: extraction excluded
tests.input: class C { m(){ return this; } } const f = new C().m; f();
tests.expected_behavior: detached call has undefined this and this rule must not be used
